_comment: G2 Collectors SLOs from Lab 2 (statistics-service) as k6 thresholds. errorRate = availability SLO 99.5 % -> 0.005 (k6 counts every failed request across all steps, so this is stricter than the 5xx-only SLI). Statistics steps: >= 95 % < 300 ms and >= 99 % < 1 s. The other steps have no SLO of their own; they keep the 1 s placeholder so they appear in the summary. Data freshness (cached_at < 30 min) is not a request metric and cannot be expressed here.
